subject: biology

hotspots.label: Cytosol
hotspots.description: The fluid part of the cytoplasm - mostly water with dissolved molecules.
hotspots.positionHint: Across the translucent interior of the model.
hotspots.function: The watery fluid in which everything in a cell is suspended.

hotspots.label: Organelles in the cytoplasm
hotspots.description: Small structures like the mitochondria and ribosomes float in the cytoplasm.
hotspots.positionHint: Several small blobs spread in the filling.
hotspots.function: The organelles are supported and held in place by the cytoplasm.

hotspots.label: Cytoplasmic transport
hotspots.description: The streaming movement that carries materials from one part of the cell to another.
hotspots.positionHint: A line of small dots drifting across the filling.
hotspots.function: Delivers materials between the membrane and organelles through the fluid.

hotspots.label: Cytoplasm fill
hotspots.description: The whole workspace between the cell membrane and nucleus, holding all organelles.
hotspots.positionHint: The entire volume inside the translucent cell boundary.
hotspots.function: Hosts reactions and supports the organelles that do the cell's work.

visualStyleNotes: Same warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC), soft vignette, no floor grid, no props. The cell is a translucent rounded blob, its interior gel shown as a soft cloud (very low opacity). Each organelle is a simple, low-saturation shape in the Biology palette. A few soft streaming dots in muted blue accent drift through. Strong color reserved for hotspot dots.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, the cytoplasmic gel is translucent (alpha ~0.1-0.15), organelles opaque matte. No emissive.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a translucent eukaryotic cell interior study. A rounded translucent cell membrane envelope. Inside, fill the volume with a near-invisible soft gel (low-opacity paper-colored cloud). Scatter a nucleus (large), a mitochondrion, a few ribosomes, an endoplasmic reticulum and a Golgi, all muted and low saturation. A thin trail of ~12 small pale-blue dots circles across the inside to indicate streaming transport. Named nodes: CytoplasmGel, NucleusMesh, MitochondrionMesh, Ribosome_Small01-04, ERMesh, GolgiMesh, StreamingTrail. The streaming trail may be a simple curved line of dots the runtime animates. Budget 8-12k. Camera framing leaves negative space.
referenceMatch: Object floats alone centered, slow auto-rotate, on warm off-white ground, no props.
